name: Any.do
description: Any.do is a task management, daily planner, and calendar app that synchronizes personal to-do lists, daily schedules, and collaborative team workspaces across all devices.
best_for: Individuals, freelancers, and small teams seeking an intuitive daily planner that combines to-do tasks and calendar events in one view.
features: Any.do Moment: daily planning assistant prompting users to review and schedule daily tasks each morning
Integrated Calendar view unifying Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook with task to-do items
Smart natural language parsing for fast recurring task entry and location-based reminders
WhatsApp integration allowing users to create tasks and reminders directly via WhatsApp messages
Collaborative team workspaces with kanban boards, task assignments, and progress tracking
Cross-platform synchronization spanning mobile, desktop, smartwatches, and smart assistants (Siri, Alexa)

tiers.name: Personal Free
tiers.notes: Core task lists, basic calendar integration, and daily planner.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Advanced recurring reminders, WhatsApp integration, color tags, and location reminders (billed annually at $36/yr or $5/mo monthly).

tiers.name: Family
tiers.notes: Up to 4 users, shared lists, and family calendar (billed annually at $60/yr).

tiers.name: Teams
tiers.notes: Per seat/mo; adds collaborative kanban boards and project management (billed annually at $5/user/mo).

pros: Any.do Moment daily planning routine helps organize morning task priorities
Unique WhatsApp reminder integration allows task capture without opening the app
Clean unified calendar view merges hourly appointments with daily to-do checklists
cons: Advanced recurring reminders and location-based alerts require upgrading to Premium
Team collaboration features are simpler than dedicated project management tools like ClickUp or Asana
Free version includes occasional promotional upgrade banners

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.description: Leading productivity and task manager with natural language parsing and Karma points.
alternatives.best_for: Productivity enthusiasts wanting powerful filters, labels, and fast keyboard entry

alternatives.name: TickTick
alternatives.description: All-in-one productivity app combining task management, Pomodoro timer, and habit tracking.
alternatives.best_for: Users seeking built-in Pomodoro focus timers and daily habit trackers

alternatives.name: Things
alternatives.description: Elegant GTD task manager built exclusively for Apple devices with one-time purchase pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Apple ecosystem users wanting exquisite design and zero monthly subscriptions
